name: Tsuugaku Sharyou ni Hisomu Chikan Mania
original_name: 通学車両に潜む痴漢マニア
source:
Main character notices a beautiful girl and follows her to the train car. Her timid gestures seem to invite him for the hunt.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公注意到一名美少女，尾随她走进了电车车厢。少女那些怯生生的举动，在他看来就像在邀请自己展开猎狩。
